newsitem.title: USA: Edison Calif. nuclear unit seen up Mar 7.
newsitem.headline: Edison Calif. nuclear unit seen up Mar 7.

text.p: Edison International estimates the 1,070 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the San Onofre nuclear power plant in southern California will be restarted March 7, a company spokesman said Monday.
Restart of the unit, which has been down for scheduled refueling and maintenance since Nov 30, was originally scheduled for early February, but was delayed by the need for repairs to generator tubes.
The nuclear plant is majority owned and operated by Edison, while Enova Corp's San Diego Gas and Electric Co owns 20 percent and the cities of Anaheim and Riverside own the remaining five percent.
